_doc: Negative fixtures for the L0f knowledge corpus. Each entry is an INVALID node (or a malformed sub-graph) tagged with the check that must reject it and the expected rejection. Consumed by: L0 validator negative tests (validateGraphV2), L8 wiki-lint (SC-6 lint half), and L9 per-SC negative evals. These nodes are deliberately NOT part of expected-graph.v2.json (which is the all-valid corpus projection). repoRoot for anchor resolution is the corpus dir (this file's directory).

rejected_by_validator._doc: validateGraphV2({...}, {repoRoot: <corpusDir>}) must DROP each of these (node absent from result.data.nodes) or return fatal when it is the only node.

out_of_enum_category.expect: dropped — category not in NODE_CATEGORIES (issue category: invalid-category)

topic_missing_importance_score.expect: dropped — topic nodes require numeric importance_score (issue category: missing-importance-score)

unresolvable_anchor.expect: dropped — anchor does not resolve at repoRoot (issue category: unresolvable-anchor)

node.name: A claim with a dangling anchor.

flagged_by_wiki_lint._doc: These nodes PASS the v2 validator's hard invariants but must be FLAGGED by wiki-lint (L8). The string `importance` field (high|medium|low) is lint-enforced, not validator-enforced — wiki_page/knowledge nodes missing it are valid-but-lintable.

rejected_subgraphs._doc: Malformed subtopic_of / evidenced_by sub-graphs the validator must reject as FATAL. Provide these nodes + edges as a full graph (add version/project/etc.) to validateGraphV2.

dangling_evidenced_by_target.expect: dropped/fatal — evidenced_by target not in nodes (issue category: invalid-reference, SC-4)
